# Contributing to KsCollectionView

[日本語](CONTRIBUTING_ja.md)

## Contribution policy

We welcome reports, proposals, and questions through GitHub Issues, but we do not accept pull requests from external contributors. Every implementation change goes through the repository's own development workflow, which keeps the problem context, design decisions, verification evidence, and review quality together. Accepting patches from outside that workflow would bypass the exploration and specification work needed to assess their broader impact.

Repository collaborators make implementation changes through that workflow after an issue has been assessed. Opening an issue does not guarantee that a change will be adopted, but it gives the maintainers the evidence needed to investigate and prioritize it.

## How to open an issue

Use the [issue template chooser](https://github.com/kamusoft/KsCollectionView/issues/new/choose). You may write your answers in English or Japanese.

For a bug report, provide the affected version and platform, the smallest sequence of steps that reproduces the problem, the actual behavior, and the expected behavior. Logs and screenshots are useful when they help isolate the problem.

For a feature request, describe the problem to solve, how it affects you today, and the alternatives or workarounds you considered. Focus on the need and the evidence rather than on a specific implementation.

For a question, provide the KsCollectionView version and platform, what you have already tried, and the documentation sections you consulted. Use this form when you need help using KsCollectionView or are unsure whether a behavior is a bug.
